learner_operation: Read the explicit row operation(s), resolve indexed source and destination roles, apply the specified swap/scaling/addition to every entry while retaining other rows, and select the full resulting coefficient matrix. fixed_features.feature: 3-by-3 matrices and five math radio choices
fixed_features.justification: Every captured bank uses this shape and response format; conservative fidelity preserves workload.

fixed_features.feature: Specified row operation rather than choosing a suitable operation
fixed_features.justification: Lesson separates applying coefficient operations from subsequent augmented/identifying-operation KPs.

fixed_features.feature: Easy single swap/scaling, moderate single addition, hard two additions
fixed_features.justification: These workloads and difficulty labels occur in the eleven captured source banks; adjoining lesson KPs cover augmented matrices and operation discovery separately.

fixed_features.feature: Hard relationship is shared target with distinct donors or shared donor with distinct targets
fixed_features.justification: Both are explicitly observed: q-130010 versus q-130064/q-130065/q-10245. A chained updated donor would introduce a different dependency beyond these captured hard cases; preserving the two observed relationships is a defensible conservative family.

fixed_features.feature: Bounded integer inputs and short nonzero factors; easy scaling bank outputs integral
fixed_features.justification: Keeps source arithmetic workload. Applying integral constraints to the whole scaling bank prevents integral-format correctness cues. The source lesson explicitly permits nonzero scaling and donor multiples.
